notes: FIXTURE MISMATCH IS THE FIRST TRAP: tia is Burst I, but controlComp(carry) seats the carry in the B3 slot with liter fixed at B1 — controlComp(tia) either mis-slots her or creates an undocumented dual-B1 comp. Tests MUST build an explicit comp with tia as the (or a) B1; the re-enter assertion additionally needs the dual-B1 variant (tia + liter) to show two stage-1 casts per rotation. SHARED-PRIOR MISREAD I EXPECT: 'Activates when recovering Cover's HP' encoded as the engine's generic `recovery` trigger — that trigger fires on ANY heal effect targeting tia, so (a) a healer teammate's heals and (b) her own S2 lifesteal-HoT (if encoded as heal ticks:10) each spuriously proc the CDR + team 32.11%, inflating both rotation and damage; the discriminating count is skill1-applies == tia-burstCast-count, asserted in a comp that CONTAINS a heal emitter. Cover-recovery is name-specific: 'Max HP of Cover ▲' (S2 hitCount block) raises max and must NOT proc skill1. Stacking caveat: with only one in-kit cover-recovery per cast and a 12s stack life vs her CDR-reduced cadence, 2 CDR stacks rarely coexist in-sim — in-game the 2nd stack needs an external cover healer; do not hard-code a permanent 2-stack (−26s) assumption. The burstCdr primitive is instant-seconds while the kit line is a 12s timed stat — assert the per-proc −13s approximation explicitly rather than a CD rewrite. 'Re-enters Burst Stage 1' has NO EffectDef primitive in the provided schema — rotation-critical GAP; I include it in the load-bearing set deliberately (the objective rule bars declaring a divergent rotation line non-load-bearing) and the driver must reconcile how the engine expresses it. All magnitudes are kit-literal (DATAMINED); no ALWAYS-⚑ field is exercised except any cadence assumption behind hitCount:5 timing, which tests should avoid pinning.
